about: The 21 scripted requests (20, plus the review's number-in-wording case) for the Studio interpreter (studio-ai.test.mjs), on the Brightline example's revision 1. expect: cards = at least one valid card and nothing typed; route = the dashboard place, no AI and no card; none = no card (cards cannot do it yet, or it is a fact the AI routes). Replies are recorded in studio-ai-replies.json by studio-ai-record.mjs.
